perturbation: HDAC5 knockdown with a second independent reagent, plus rescue with siRNA-resistant wild-type HDAC5 at matched level
controls: non-targeting control; measure HDAC4 and HDAC9 for compensation; HDAC5 amount and nuclear fraction

discriminating_result: change that reverses on rescue = HDAC5-dependent; no change = INV-16 edge not supported in this system (bounded by the knockdown efficiency shown)
decision_it_would_change: INV-16 stays open or closes for this system; WO-30/WO-32 ordering
